summary: Arbe Robotics Ltd., an Israeli foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting an underwritten registered direct offering of 833,334 ordinary shares at $0.60 per share and, in lieu of shares to certain investors, pre-funded warrants to purchase up to 24,166,666 ordinary shares at $0.5999 per pre-funded warrant, which equals the share price less the $0.0001 exercise price. Gross proceeds were approximately $15.0 million. Canaccord Genuity acted as sole bookrunner. The offering was expected to close on or about September 28, 2026. The company agreed to a 90-day lock-up on new issuances. Proceeds are for working capital, general corporate purposes, and potentially strategic M&A opportunities. This is a routine capital-raising event, not a special situation.
